Counsellor Florrick is an  elven  wizard and advisor to the Archduke. Her loyalty to  Grand Duke Ravengard is beyond question. Steady as Tyr's heartbeat, as upstanding as the Sword Mountains,[1] Florrick plays a notable role in the politics brewing within Baldur's Gate, mainly through the questline ⁠Rescue the Grand Duke.
“
A scorched throat, a few hairs singed off. Nothing a bit of time and fresh air can't cure.
„
— Florrick after rescuing her

Overview

Background

Florrick is professional and dutiful in her role as a leading member of Baldur's Gate's government. While an advisor, she prefers to be direct and on-hand when it comes to handling problems which plague the city, such as the disappearance of Ulder Ravengard. Being straightforward and honest in her dealings makes her quite a rarity in the oft corrupt ranks of the city's elite.

Involvement

Act One

Florrick can first be encountered at Waukeen's Rest on the Risen Road leading west towards the Mountain Pass. Upon the party's arrival, the place is on fire after an attack by goblins and drow serving the Cult of the Absolute. Trapped on the second floor in the east-most room of the inn, Florrick can be rescued from the blaze. Once saved, she informs the party of Duke Ravengard's recent kidnapping by the cultists, assuming they took him west to Moonrise Towers. This starts ⁠Rescue the Grand Duke.

She urges the party to help in saving the Duke, more so if  Wyll is present. Upon recognizing him, she inadvertently reveals that he is Ulder's son. Upon rewarding the party for saving her, she departs from Waukeen's Rest, taking the (remaining) Flaming Fist soldiers with her to personally lead the mission to find the missing  Ulder Ravengard.

If Florrick is not rescued from the fire in time, she dies and is removed from the game, making it impossible to obtain  Florrick's Cohort as an ally in the final battle, although the ⁠Rescue the Grand Duke quest can still be obtained in Act Three.

Act Two

If Florrick survives Act One, she travels to the Last Light Inn and, upon journeying through the Shadow-Cursed Lands, the party can meet her there, in the north-eastern room on the ground floor, where she and her Flaming Fist troops are still planning a rescue for Ravengard. However, without a safe way through the cursed shadows surrounding Moonlight Towers, her efforts unfortunately are in vain, as are their attempts to get information from  Art Cullagh.

While there, the party can speak with Florrick, and gain some news from the city and its new Lord,  Gortash. She then informs the party of her plans and departs for Baldur's Gate the next day, intending to convince the council to send reinforcements for rescuing the duke.

Once the party reach Moonrise Towers, Florrick and her retinue depart for Baldur's Gate, leaving a note on the table in Last Light Inn. Thus visiting Moonrise before Last Light Inn results in finding only her note.

Act Three

In Act Three, Florrick is moved to Wyrm's Rock Prison, resigned as she awaits execution after being found guilty of crimes against the city of Baldur's Gate by none other than Ulder Ravengard. If the party decide to rescue her, she is reinvigorated, pledges her aid in the final battle and  Florrick's Cohort becomes one of the allies the party can call upon. Party members with the  Criminal background also gain the inspiration ⁠Wrongly Convicted.

If Florrick is not rescued within five long rests after ⁠Free Counsellor Florrick starts, she is executed by hanging and her body remains suspended from the gallows at the Basilisk Gate.

If Wyll breaks his pact with  Mizora during ⁠The Blade of Frontiers and forsakes his father, Florrick approaches Wyll and the party while they are in Baldur's Gate, with the intent to avenge Ravengard. A fight can be avoided by passing a  DC 18 Persuasion Check or a  DC 15 History Check. If she is convinced, and presuming Ravengard is dead, Florrick gives Wyll  The Legend of Ansur[2] and directs the party to the next step of his personal quest. If all attempts to reason with Florrick fail, she and her retinue of Flaming Fists become hostile. In this case, the book must be acquired by other means.

Epilogue

If ⁠The Blade of Frontiers is completed, and  Wyll chooses to ascend politically as the next Grand Duke of Baldur's Gate, he mentions during the epilogue party that Florrick is now the Grand Duke of the Crossing, The Face of Devotion.[3] If Ulder Ravengard is dead, Wyll entrusts the command of the Flaming Fist to Florrick, and mentions that she has pardoned most Fists, having said "With a few exceptions, Florrick's pardoned every last Fist.".[4]

Combat

Attacks and Abilities (Act 1)

 Hypnotic Pattern ( + )

 Hypnotise creatures that can see the pattern. They cannot attack you. They cannot move nor act.

This spell can be cast while you are  Silenced.

 WIS Save
 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Mage Armour ( + )

Surround an unarmoured creature in a protective magical force. Its  Armour Class increases to 13 + its Dexterity modifier.

This effect does not stack with Unarmoured Defence.

 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Magic Missile ( + )
Damage: 6~15

Damage: 8~64
8d8⁠Cold
Make a flurry of frost, crisp air, and condensed snow crystals erupt from your hands.
 CON Save

 Fire Shield ( + )

Wreathe your body in flames that shed light in a 3 m (10 ft) radius, provide Resistance to ⁠Fire or ⁠Cold damage, and retaliate against melee attacks.

 Range: Self
 Otto's Irresistible Dance ( + )

Cause a creature to start dancing, making it unable to take Actions or Move. Its attackers have  Advantage on  Attack rolls.
